subject: CloudRelay delegated telemetry bridge - temporary processor notice & evidence request
messages:
From: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@cloudrelay.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: onboarding@cloudrelay.com
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: Temporary telemetry bridge (delegated processor) for Novapay - onboarding window

Hi Diego / Kimberly,

Hope you both are well. Quick heads-up: CloudRelay will act as a temporary telemetry processor for Novapay’s pilot environment starting June 20th to July 4th to support a high-volume test window. This is a short-term delegated role (only telemetry/event batches — no PII payloads).

What we’re providing with this notice:
- High-level scope: collection of anonymized telemetry + service metrics. No customer-identifiable content (we've flagged filters in the config).
- Location: primary processing in us-west-2; failover to us-east-1 only.
- Security controls: TLS in transit, AES-256 at rest, per-tenant encryption keys (KMS) — we can provide key rotation schedule.
- Evidence bundle: SOC2 summary, network topology for telemetry bridge, DPA addendum draft (attached).

Action requested from Redwood: please confirm whether this temporary delegation is acceptable to Novapay and provide any evidence requests or export restrictions we should be aware of. We will need a signed addendum before the cutover.

Attachments: cloudrelay-dpa-addendum.pdf (stub), network-topology-telemetry.png (stub), cloudrelay-soc2-summary.pdf (stub)

Happy to hop on a quick call if it helps.

Regards,
Carlos Ruiz
Head of Integrations
CloudRelay
From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@cloudrelay.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: Temporary telemetry bridge (delegated processor) for Novapay - onboarding window

Thanks for the heads-up Carlos — Diego here.

A few quick clarifying asks before we engage Novapay:
1) You mention "no PII" — can you confirm the exact filter logic you're applying? A short sampling of the filter rules would be great.
2) KMS: who holds the CMK? Is CloudRelay using its own KMS or can Redwood/Novapay escrow keys for this window?
3) Residency: you note failover to us-east-1 — we need assurance that no EU egress will occur (our customer has EU tenants flagged).
4) Incident response: please include your on-call escalation path and SLA for telemetry ingestion failures.

Kimberly / Naomi — tagging you since procurement/legal will likely want the SOC2 artifact and the DPA addendum checked for export controls. Short on time here so any red flags — call them out.

Diego
Director, Product Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@cloudrelay.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: onboarding@cloudrelay.com
Date: Wed, 6 Jun 2028 08:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: Temporary telemetry bridge (delegated processor) for Novapay - onboarding window

Diego — thanks for the fast reply. Answers below and attached the evidence bundle.

1) Filter logic: We strip known identifier fields server-side by default and apply a redaction rule set before persistence. Sample rule snippets (pseudocode) included in the network-topology-telemetry.png notes. We will also accept a pre-ingest hook if Redwood wants to enforce an additional regex.

2) KMS: CloudRelay will use tenant-specific keys in our AWS KMS under a CloudRelay account. For this temporary engagement we can enable a customer-managed key (CMK) if Novapay requests; key usage is constrained to the telemetry S3 bucket. Let us know preference and we’ll update the addendum.

3) Residency: confirmed — us-west-2 primary, failover us-east-1 only. No EU regions will be used during this window. We can add an explicit clause to the addendum to prevent cross-border routing.

4) Incident response / SLAs: 24x7 ingestion alerting, 15-minute P1 acknowledgement, full post-incident report within 72 hours. On-call: +1-415-555-0199 (pager), ops@cloudrelay.com.

Attachments included (stubs): cloudrelay-dpa-addendum.pdf, network-topology-telemetry.png, cloudrelay-soc2-summary.pdf

Quote from the addendum: "Processing limited to anonymized telemetry; no storage of authentication tokens or payment identifiers."

If that looks acceptable I can route a DocuSign for the addendum and we’ll schedule the short pre-cutover review.

Best,
Carlos
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@cloudrelay.com>, diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Jun 2028 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: Temporary telemetry bridge (delegated processor) for Novapay - onboarding window

Carlos — thanks for the details and the artifacts. Reviewed the SOC2 summary and the addendum draft. A couple of procurement/legal items to close before we sign:

- Please add an explicit data residency clause (no EU routing) and a sentence preventing secondary processing for analytics without prior written consent.
- For KMS, Novapay prefers a customer-managed CMK for the pilot; please update the addendum to include the CMK option and the key rotation cadence.
- We need a short statement on retention: telemetry retained max 30 days unless Novapay instructs otherwise.
- Send a redaction rule excerpt in plain text (not embedded in an image) that we can attach to the addendum.

Assuming you can accept those edits we are ok to proceed. Diego / Naomi — if no objections I’ll ask legal to prepare the addendum redlines and route to Novapay for signature (DocuSign link requested).

Kimberly Park
Sr. Contracts Manager
Redwood Inference
